newsitem.title: USA: Melamine Chemicals ups N.American prices.
newsitem.headline: Melamine Chemicals ups N.American prices.

text.p: Melamine Chemicals Inc said Monday it was increasing prices in North America by $0.02 per pound effective June 1, 1997.
The price increase will apply to list price and off list price customers as contracts allow, the company said.
It said this was the first price increase since October 1995.
Melamine Chemicals is one of two producers of melamine in North America and one of the three largest producers worldwide, according to the company.
